comments.value:
this button won't push people to buy vrc+

If you want subscribers, develop subscription benefits.

At least let us paying customers hide this.

The quick menu is cluttered enough as it is.
Oh, another good reason to AVOID vrc+
We do not need this in Quick Menu at all. This will interfere with the muscle memory and we already have a button on the home page.
This instead of new features is crazy, just canceled my sub.

Xrosspost from the discussion channel:

If it is staying, it's going to need to move next to the settings. on the right.

So it stays out of the way of everyone's muscle memory.

Honestly, the issue isn't with the button itself, it's with the placement. You can tell what kind of intent they had with this. Instead of putting it all the way on the left/right, they put it right in between the launch pad and notifications. Instead of people going like, oo what's this new tab here, oh vrc+! cool! I might sub to that-

They will keep missclicking it and being like wtf is this? and complain. And in turn make the experience of VRC worse. You think this makes people sub to VRC+ more? Give it more features and don't shove it in our faces with predatory behaviour like this. Be fair to us, don't take advantage of us, it's disgusting. This is why people now completely block ads on YouTube, instead of buying YouTube Premium. Don't make the experience worse for the users, make it better for the ones that are loyal and want to support you, instead of forcing the people that enjoy your platform to buy your subs.
Muscle memory, really hate this position, I have touched it by mistake many times, it's so annoying!!

Marking this as tracked, however we won't be removing the tab. 

Instead, we hear you that the position is the most frustrating part of this addition, and we'll be moving the tab to a different position. It looks like we're moving it to the second-to-the-last position, one spot left of the Settings tab.

[This feedback item](https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/vrc-qm-tab-should-be-last-accessible-tab) is tracked under the same issue since closer to what we'll be doing.
@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} Optionally, you could add it to the top right, where VRCat and VRC Credits are positioned. If it had to stay as a bottom row tab, keep it last.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} why not just make the cat the tab? its been sitting up their doing nothing for quite a few years now, single click to pet the cat, double click to open your vrcplus supporter menu as we have it now with this tab. instead of moving it integrate it what we already have vrchats already complained in the past about further cluttering the menu with requests regarding vram settings, doesn't this remove one extra bit of clutter while keeping functionality?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} That's still going to be an issue for me

The proposed location would put it between audio and settings. I often have to adjust world audio, or go into settings.

At the start of this open beta I had seen the feedback post you linked, but I had decided not to vote it for this reason.

Why not make the toggle in the settings?

Why not to hide it when user have no vrc+ and it's useless (literally can't do anything)?

Thanks for all the feedback in the replies to this comment!

For the moment, we plan on rolling with the new position next to the Settings menu. We'll be watching our metrics to see if it fulfills the goals set out by this change, as well as making sure it doesn't disrupt typical usage of VRChat.

If we see that it isn't accomplishing what we want it to do, we'll iterate further.

details: I understand the need to promote your subscriptions, but placing an ad in the quick menu feels unnecessary. The quick menu is supposed to be minimalistic and straightforward. You already have plenty of opportunities to advertise VRC+, like in the banner or when clicking the profile icon. There's no need to clutter the quick menu with it. This space would be much better used for important features, like the upcoming Udon Menus!
title: [1501] Remove VRC+ Icon In Quick Menu
